verdict.rationale: GitHub documents natural-language operation in several places. Copilot Chat Ask/Agent modes take plain prompts like 'Update the website to allow searching for running races by name' and generate edits. The cloud agent lets users explore repos, plan changes and delegate tasks from GitHub.com and mobile. The official GitHub MCP server lets users work with repositories, issues and pull requests directly from Copilot Chat, and Copilot CLI brings this to the terminal. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language control, and evidence that natural-language commands extend beyond code, repos, issues and PRs to administrative or settings operations.
